pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Arrows are rejected independently of other monsters’ settings. Trident damage, fall damage and direct fire contact are rejected too. Prepare melee equipment instead of relying on shooting or knocking it off a ledge.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Infected Chorus Fruit. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
